value.rationale: Correlated reset-site selection is physically meaningful and introduces finite-state memory absent from scalar renewal calculations. The result shows that the leading rate and exit-side bias depend exactly on stationary weighted one-jump hazards, and that reset frequency, nonreversibility and higher temporal correlations disappear at leading order. Full law and moment convergence make this a usable transport-design characterization.
